dataset_title: Codex CV plotting dataset: original indices 1-100 per folder
selection: Exact numeric filename indices 1 through 100, inclusive, from each listed source folder.
folder_labels: Folder names are retained from the user's source project. They are not independently validated mechanistic classifications.
format_note: Most files use % COMSOL comments and whitespace-delimited numeric triples. SR uses # comments, a named header, and tab-delimited values. Blank lines may occur.

column_definitions.unit: V where explicitly labelled in each header
A only where verified; see each file record

current_unit_policy: SR explicitly labels Current/A. For other folders, A is recorded only if the raw export is byte-identical to a generator-output copy, its header model name matches the audited source model, and dmodel.xml pairs tcd.Itot_es1 with unit A. Files lacking this linkage remain unverified; preserve raw values and skip display-unit conversion until metadata is established.
cycle_candidate_policy: A numerical full-sweep candidate requires at least 20 rows, one potential-direction reversal, a return to its first potential within twice the largest observed nonzero potential step (minimum tolerance 1e-8 V), and coverage of the full export's observed potential range within that tolerance. This is recorded evidence, not a blanket assertion that every cycle is complete. Review source settings and candidate trace before scientific interpretation.
plot_rules: Preserve row order within the chosen cycle; do not sort by potential.
Do not smooth, interpolate, resample, normalize, subtract a baseline, or shift potential.
Use explicitly verified units; record unresolved units and skip conversion.
Compare across folders only after checking model metadata. A folder label alone does not establish the reason for different CV shapes.
No source models were rerun or modified.

verified_E_provenance.ledger_row_linkage: Generator increments Table_N_E from 1 in parameter-table row order. Each selected ONE/E export has identical SHA256 to the generator-output copy in E_model_Version1_i0_over_cbulk/cv_table/cv_table. Ledger v values also match Cdl*v charging plateaus.
verified_E_provenance.current_A_evidence: The matching model .mph ZIP contains savepoint2/savepoint.xml scalar root.comp1.tcd.Itot_es1 description Total_current unit A. dmodel.xml result expr tcd.Itot_es1 uses unit A; separate tcd.itotavg_es1 variable is current density.
verified_E_provenance.model_area_convention: dmodel.xml global tcd param Ac=1[m^2]. Preserve the exported total current; do not silently divide by area or invent a laboratory electrode area.
verified_E_provenance.potential_reference: dmodel.xml phisref=0[V], ElectrodeReaction Eeq_ref=0[V]. An experimental reference electrode identity is not supplied; use Electric potential (V), model reference.
